children.value: > Fact From Story: A Flexport spokesperson rejected that characterization
> > Fact From Story: Evidence to support Flexport's claims of financial mismanagement is lacking, raising questions about whether that narrative was put forward to justify Clark's exit.
> > > Fact From Story: Petersen has publicly said Clark overspent, overhired and overpromised, something his allies echoed to CNBC.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Claims of overspending, overhiring, and overpromising can be interpreted as claims of financial mismanagement.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A spokesperson is likely to deny claims that reflect poorly on their company.

> Fact From Story: "Ryan Petersen returned as CEO in order to restore Flexport's culture of customer engagement, and drive the growth and cost discipline required to return the company to profitability," the spokesperson said in a statement.
> > Fact From Story: Ryan Petersen returned as CEO.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: CEOs often make statements regarding the goals and direction of the company.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A spokesperson speaks on behalf of an organization and its leaders.
